name: Empire 8 Cross Country Championships
headline: Empire 8 Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: SUNY Geneseo swept the team titles for the third straight year. The Geneseo women scored a perfect 15 ahead of Nazareth (78) and Brockport (84), and Geneseo’s Ari Reback won the 6K in 21:50.1. The Geneseo men won with 24 points over Houghton (81) and Brockport (86); Geneseo’s Collin Brown won the 8K in 25:10.1.
